findings.onboarding.config.no_manage_roles: The bot lacks **Manage Roles**, so onboarding can't give members their roles. Give the bot's role Manage Roles in Server Settings → Roles.
findings.onboarding.config.completion_role_missin: The onboarding completion role (`{roleId}`) no longer exists. Pick another one with `/onboarding completion-role`.
findings.onboarding.config.completion_role_unassi: The onboarding completion role <@&{roleId}> is managed by an integration or is @everyone, so no bot can grant it. Pick another role.
findings.onboarding.config.completion_role_above_: The onboarding completion role <@&{roleId}> is at or above the bot's highest role, so members never get it. Drag the bot's role above it in Server Settings → Roles.
findings.onboarding.config.step_duplicate_id: Onboarding step {step} reuses the id `{stepId}` of an earlier step, so members never see it. `/onboarding step-remove` would remove the earlier step (the one members do see), so give this step a new id where it was set up (the dashboard).
findings.onboarding.config.step_unknown_type: Onboarding step {step} (`{stepId}`) has the unknown type `{type}` and is skipped (a required one stops onboarding there). Fix its type where it was set up (the dashboard), or remove it with `/onboarding step-remove`.
findings.onboarding.config.step_id_too_long: Onboarding step {step} has an id too long for Discord's 100-character button ids, so it can't be sent (a required one stops onboarding there). Give it a shorter id where it was set up (the dashboard); steps added with `/onboarding step-add` always get short ids.
findings.onboarding.config.step_too_many_options: Onboarding step {step} (`{stepId}`) offers more than 25 roles, the most a Discord menu holds, so it can't be sent. Remove some.
findings.onboarding.config.step_duplicate_role: Onboarding step {step} (`{stepId}`) lists the same role twice, so Discord rejects the menu. Remove the duplicate.
findings.onboarding.config.step_role_missing: Onboarding step {step} (`{stepId}`) offers a role that no longer exists (`{roleId}`). It can be removed from the step.
findings.onboarding.config.step_role_unassignable: Onboarding step {step} (`{stepId}`) offers <@&{roleId}>, which is managed by an integration or is @everyone, so no bot can grant it.
findings.onboarding.config.step_role_above_bot: Onboarding step {step} (`{stepId}`) offers <@&{roleId}>, which is at or above the bot's highest role, so picking it does nothing. Drag the bot's role above it in Server Settings → Roles.
findings.onboarding.config.error: Couldn't check the onboarding settings. Try again later.
